picks.title: Burke Olsen: Publishing Peace
picks.summary: In this devotional, Burke Olsen teaches that each of us is a publisher, and that our words, actions, and choices can help bring peace into the world. Drawing from the history of publishing in the Restoration and his experiences in journalism, he explores three ways we can “publish peace”: through singing hymns, what we post and share online, and keeping a journal. Brother Olsen encourages students to choose peace over contention, build others up, and use every opportunity to share the light and truth of the gospel of Jesus Christ. picks.reason: Devotional on spreading peace through words and actions in Restoration context.
